bug_semantics: An authenticated Administration Console user can persist attacker-controlled HTML in a configuration attribute such as an application's description. A later authenticated request for that object through the management REST interface negotiates text/html, and ProviderUtil inserts the stored attribute directly into an HTML input value attribute without HTML-attribute encoding. A value such as "> closes the value attribute and creates an executable element in the victim administrator's browser.
flaw_origin: The exact surviving sink originated in javaee/glassfish commit 881906985072f3326ed2a53d3aa2f07a2c0973f8, which added browser-based update/create/delete forms and added getHtmlRespresentationForAttributes with raw proxy.attribute(attribute) concatenation into value="...". Later moves, the 2018 Eclipse initial-contribution aggregate, API migrations, and refactors preserved that unencoded data flow as proxy.attribute(xmlAttributeName) -> getHtmlRespresentationForParameter -> raw parameterValue interpolation.
ai_marker: absent: the BIC commit object names human author and committer Rajeshwar Patil <rajeshwar@java.net>; its complete message contains the feature description, 'svn path=/trunk/; revision=30516', and 'Former-commit-id: 9704950d4e40962670d45dda27c9a5fa76bfaf4e', with no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI, bot, or other AI-attribution trailer.
evidence: First-party report https://gitlab.eclipse.org/security/vulnerability-reports/-/issues/230 identifies authenticated stored XSS: POST parameter form:war:psection:descriptionProp:description at /common/applications/uploadFrame.jsf stores the payload ">, which executes when another administrator visits /management/domain/applications/application/; it also reports the same mechanism for a stored protocol name.
The advisory bundle identifies CVE-2024-9343 / GHSA-mqxx-c43h-jj9v, package org.glassfish.main.admingui:console-common, affected range <= 7.0.25, and no first_patched_version.

The current source path nucleus/admin/rest/rest-service/src/main/java/org/glassfish/admin/rest/provider/ProviderUtil.java passes proxy.attribute(xmlAttributeName) into getHtmlRespresentationForParameter and, when hasValue is true, builds '<input ... value ="' + parameterValue + '" ...>' without ResourceUtil.encodeString or any HTML-attribute encoder. ActionReportResultHtmlProvider.java is @Produces(TEXT_HTML) and calls this builder for management entities.

Public predecessor history was required because eclipse-ee4j/glassfish starts at parentless aggregate 571714739b23e16c4c90d5229b806433920b3bcb ('Initial Contribution'). The javaee/glassfish history follows ProviderUtil.java through repository moves to BIC 881906985072f3326ed2a53d3aa2f07a2c0973f8; its diff adds getHtmlRespresentationForAttributes and the exact raw proxy.attribute(attribute) value-attribute concatenation.

Direct parent-tree verification against bc3bc2bffef6c015dc3e6252b3fea9cb73447d7e shows ProviderUtil.java exists but ends after getStatistics and has no getHtmlRespresentationForAttributes method, no HTML form builder, and no raw proxy.attribute(attribute) value-attribute sink. Therefore the vulnerable lines are absent at the immediate parent.

The BIC commit object at https://github.com/javaee/glassfish/commit/881906985072f3326ed2a53d3aa2f07a2c0973f8 records parent bc3bc2bffef6c015dc3e6252b3fea9cb73447d7e, human authorship by Rajeshwar Patil on 2009-08-18, and no AI marker or attribution trailer.

Version check: tag 7.0.15 exists and git show 7.0.15:nucleus/admin/rest/rest-service/src/main/java/org/glassfish/admin/rest/provider/ProviderUtil.java contains the same unencoded parameterValue interpolation, so the 2009 BIC precedes and is a member of the affected code lineage.

No fix was found: git log --all -S'ResourceUtil.encodeString(parameterValue)' for ProviderUtil.java returns no commits; a 7.0.15..7.0.26 path diff changes only unrelated imports/readAsString removal and Boolean parsing while retaining the raw sink; current main HEAD 4a143866f4a92995e6387ee33f5412bdeac38567 still contains the sink. Thus no fix SHA or actual patched-version boundary exists in public history as audited.
reasoning: The lifecycle begins with the 2009 browser-write feature, not with the 2018 Eclipse import or a later formatting refactor. Commit 881906985072f3326ed2a53d3aa2f07a2c0973f8 is the smallest change that added the surviving management HTML form sink: it reads a configuration attribute and places it raw inside a quoted input value. Its immediate parent lacks that method and sink. Subsequent predecessor-repository moves and the parentless Eclipse initial-contribution aggregate preserve the code, and tag 7.0.15 demonstrably contains the same raw interpolation used by the report's stored-description attack. The source is also unchanged in its security-relevant behavior in 7.0.26 and current main, so the advisory's null first-patched version is consistent and fix_sha/direct_fix_sha must remain null. AI attribution is judged only from the reconstructed BIC commit object: it is a 2009 human commit by Rajeshwar Patil with no AI author, bot identity, co-author, generated-with, or AI trailer. The causal and attribution evidence therefore supports NOT_AI despite the vulnerability remaining unpatched.
remaining_gap: Upstream has not published a fix: 7.0.26 and current main still retain the vulnerable HTML-attribute interpolation, so there is no fix commit or patched boundary to record.
